product_family: CapCut is a free AI-powered video and image editing platform with multiple products: CapCut Desktop (desktop app), CapCut Online (web editor), CapCut Pad (tablet app), and CapCut Mobile (iOS/Android apps). Also includes Dreamina AI (image/video generation) and Pippit AI (creative agent). Owned by ByteDance (Chinese conglomerate).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. RFP.wiki assessment explicitly states: 'No certifications identified in the analysis.'

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. CapCut's privacy policy contains only general statement: 'technical, administrative, and organisational measures' with no third-party audit.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. Privacy policy does not mention ISO 27001 or any ISO standards. RFP.wiki: 'Limited public evidence of industry certifications.'

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: CapCut lacks formal DPA and relies on standard contractual clauses. Compliance concerns noted per Articles 13-14 (transparency) and 17 (right to deletion). No explicit GDPR certification on vendor domain.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: CapCut is not subject to HIPAA and makes no HIPAA compliance claims. Not a healthcare provider or business associate under HIPAA definitions.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. CapCut does not process payment card data directly; this is handled by app stores (Apple, Google).

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. No third-party certifications listed.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (Personal Data Protection)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. Personal data handling not covered by any cited certification.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. CapCut heavily uses AI for content generation and ML training but has no AI governance certification.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. CapCut does not market itself as a government-approved cloud service.

certifications.name: CSA STAR Certification
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. Cloud Security Alliance certification not mentioned.

privacy.ai_training_note: CapCut trains on user-uploaded content. The privacy policy states: 'train, test, and improve technology, such as machine learning models and algorithms.' Users grant a broad license: 'non-exclusive, royalty-free, transferable, sub-licensable, perpetual and worldwide licence to use your User Content.' No opt-out is available.

security.name: Security Guarantee
security.value: 'We do not guarantee that our Services will be secure or free from bugs or viruses.' No SLA or status page is published.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: General mention of 'advanced encryption' but not specific (TLS version, cipher suites not disclosed). No third-party audit.

security.name: Data Centers
security.value: Located in Malaysia, Singapore, and United States. No specific facility certifications mentioned.

security.name: Security Audits
security.value: Referenced as 'regular security audits' but no public audit reports, frequency, or third-party attestation provided.

security.name: Biometric Data
security.value: Face/body data deleted after applying effects but collected and analyzed for processing. Lawsuit alleges improper biometric data harvesting (ongoing).

security.name: Health Data Collection
security.value: CapCut may collect inferred health information from user content, including physical and mental health conditions. Separate Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy published.

products.name: CapCut Desktop
products.data_scope: User-uploaded videos, images, audio; clipboard access; local file system access (on user's machine)
products.notes: Powerful desktop editor with AI features. Free with optional paid features.

products.name: CapCut Online
products.data_scope: User-uploaded videos, images, audio stored on CapCut servers (Malaysia, Singapore, US)
products.notes: Browser-based editor, no installation required. Data leaves user device immediately.

products.name: CapCut Mobile (iOS/Android)
products.data_scope: Device media library, camera/microphone, clipboard, contacts. Data uploaded to servers for processing.
products.notes: Most widely used variant (100M+ downloads). App Store rating 4.7/5 but subject to class-action lawsuit.

products.name: CapCut Pad
products.data_scope: Similar to mobile app but optimized for tablet UI

products.name: Dreamina AI
products.data_scope: Text prompts, reference images, generated outputs. Uses external AI models.
products.notes: AI-powered image and video creation tool. Seedance 2.0 update in development.

products.name: Pippit AI
products.notes: AI assistant for creative projects. Limited public information.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: Free tier with watermark, paid Premium removes watermark and adds features. No enterprise pricing model.
compare.data_residency: Multi-region: Malaysia, Singapore, United States. No EU data residency guarantee despite GDPR claims.
top_certs: NONE - No formal security certifications held

flags: A Nudge Security profile claims CapCut holds SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR certifications; these claims are not supported by vendor domain evidence. An RFP.wiki assessment explicitly states 'No certifications identified.'

A class-action lawsuit filed July 28, 2023 in US District Court (Northern District of Illinois) alleges illegal biometric data harvesting and privacy violations. A March 2025 ruling allowed privacy claims under the California Constitution and Illinois BIPA to proceed. A September 2025 update dismissed Computer Fraud and Abuse Act claims, but BIPA and privacy claims remain active.
CapCut trains ML models on user-uploaded content with no opt-out; this is a core business practice. No data minimization is evident.
The Terms of Service state: 'We do not guarantee that our Services will be secure or free from bugs or viruses.'
No formal DPA exists; CapCut relies on standard contractual clauses, and there are documented concerns under GDPR Article 13/14 (transparency) and Article 17 (right to deletion).
CapCut collects and infers health information from user content (a separate Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy is published for this); this data is also subject to AI training.
CapCut is a ByteDance product; legal entity Bytedance Pte. Ltd. (Singapore).
Rated 2.6/5 by RFP.wiki. Suitable for social creators, not enterprise use; no SSO, SCIM, DLP, or other enterprise controls, and no third-party plugin ecosystem.

A consumer trust center exists (capcut.com/trust/, with Privacy, Safety, Responsible AI, and Legal sections), but it publishes no third-party audit reports, attestations, or formal certifications. Security detail such as encryption and audit cadence is described only in general terms across multiple policy documents.
